answer_1.quote: Task 2 (path text): Given a KB path x B , generate a descriptive sentence x A , coherently merging entities and relation from the path. This conditional generation is a translation task referred to as T BA , where x BA = T BA (x B ).
answer_1.outputs: a descriptive sentence or a KB path (tuple)

answer_2.quote: For text generation, we rely on traditional NLP metrics such as BLEU and ROUGE. ... We use the following metrics to evaluate generated sentence quality: BLEU2 (B2), BLEU3 (B3), ROUGEL (R_L), and F1 BERT-score (B_F1). ... We employ the Graph Edit Distance (GED) to examine the quality of the generated graph as a whole. ... For KB completion ... MRR and HITS as evaluation ranking metrics.
